title: Metadata Builder Inputs
description: Typed inputs for the metadata-builder agent. This schema is the machine-readable form of the Inputs table in AGENT.md. Everything else the agent needs comes from the step record inside plan.json, not from the caller.

build_dir.description: Path to the build directory containing plan.json, e.g. .sfskills/builds/case-onboarding/. All artefacts are written under <build_dir>/artefacts/<step_id>/ and nowhere else.

step_id.description: Id of the single step to build. Must appear in plan.json steps[] with `agent: metadata-builder` and a `type` that is a row in the standards/build-orchestration.md section 4 table. Must match the `M<n>-S<nn>` form that agents/_shared/schemas/build-plan.schema.json requires.

api_version.description: Salesforce API version stamped into the package.xml <version> element and into any component type that carries one. Defaults to the plan's api_version when it declares one, then to 62.0.
